body_revisions.scope: Desired configuration, observed resource and durable state
body_revisions.observation: Eight complete sections define configuration, provider read, in-memory/saved plan, apply and persisted state before locks, refresh modes and workspace ownership. Detailed exit code0/1/2 explicitly requires -detailed-exitcode; actual local provider records and full sources retain their boundary.
